AGENT_VOIP.NO_EXTENSIONS: No extensions configured in this account.

AGENT_VOIP.NO_SERVICES: No VoIP service is available. Ask an administrator to configure and authorize one.
AGENT_VOIP.NO_BINDING: Configure your extension in your profile to make and receive calls.
AGENT_VOIP.SERVICE_MISMATCH: Select and activate this favorite's service in your profile before calling.
AGENT_VOIP.SECRET_SAVED: Credential configured. Leave blank to keep it.
AGENT_VOIP.TEST_OK: SIP registration confirmed. No call was started.
AGENT_VOIP.NAME: Name

AGENT_VOIP.SERVICE_HELP: Shared service configuration. Each agent manages extension credentials in their profile.
AGENT_VOIP.BUSY_HELP: End the call before changing the service or extension.
